query: UPDATE central.approvals SET version = $6, state = $7, decision_actor = NULLIF($8, ''), decision_reason = NULLIF($9, ''), decision_id = $10, decided_at = $11, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND task_id = $2 AND run_id = $3 AND step_id = $4 AND id = $5 AND version = $12 AND approval_kind = 'execution'
